---
title: "1. Data Wrangling"
author: "Solveig Sølverød Mo and Eve Zeyl Fiskebeck"
date: "`r format(Sys.time(), '%d %B, %Y')`"
params:
    pjs_df: "data/path.xlsx"
    pjs_sheet: "Cleaned_data" 
    vigas_df: "data/path.xlsx"
    source_code: 'code/R'
execute: 
  echo: false
  cache: false
format: html
knitr:
  opts_chunk: 
    collapse: true
    comment: "#>" 
    R.options:
      knitr.graphics.auto_pdf: true
editor_options: 
  chunk_output_type: console
---

```{r setup}
library(here)
library(tidyverse)
library("RColorBrewer")
```


<!-- comment this if using Rstudio --> 
```{r params for vscode}
params <- list()
params$pjs_df <- "data/path.xlsx"
params$pjs_sheet <- "Cleaned_data" 
params$vigas_df <- "data/path.xlsx"
params$source_code <- 'code/R'

params$source_code
here::here(params$source_code)
```


```{r source reused functions}
fun_files_path <- list.files(
  here::here(params$source_code), 
  pattern = "*.R", 
  full.names = TRUE
  )
# sourcing all the functions 
sapply(fun_files_path,source,.GlobalEnv)
```
